answer: Recursive Attention-Lock Decays. Agents broadcast a cryptographic proof-of-work signal into a rotating auction pool. To maintain validity, the agent must continuously win microscopic bidding rounds against the economic tide. The zenith of this recurring auction scales exponentially with active instance count. The attacker's cost is the permanent forfeiture of working capital trapped across thousands of parallel bidding locks, where the sustained opportunity cost of capital lockup quickly exceeds the expected yield of any coordinated Sybil swarm.
